name: todd-w-shaffer
description: Claude Code plugins by Todd Shaffer

plugins.name: coolant
plugins.description: Thermal management for Claude Code — caps test runner concurrency, suppresses build tools during parallel mode

plugins.name: commit-skill
plugins.description: Structured narrative commits (/commit) and the post-commit propagation cascade (/ship), with a per-commit cost line and an opt-in git gate that admits a Claude Code session's commits only through /commit or /ship

plugins.name: ship-skill
plugins.description: Moved to commit-skill: install commit-skill 2.1.0+ and use /commit-skill:ship. This copy still works but is no longer updated, and comes off the marketplace in a later release

plugins.name: sittings
plugins.description: Bookends for a unit of work: /savor audits a spec before implementation, /observations surfaces what review can't reach after it

plugins.name: clearmind
plugins.description: Audit auto-memory for stale, shipped, redundant, or trivial entries, then apply removals after approval
